item.title: Meet the 2026 CFMU Bursary Recipient: Abbie Mamba
item.description: Every fundraising season, 93.3 CFMU spotlights a dedicated student volunteer who powers community radio. To honour their contributions, the station established the CFMU Bursary during its 45th anniversary with the aim of materially supporting student volunteers committed to campus radio. This year’s recipient, Abbie Mamba, is a third-year McMaster student majoring in communication studies and political science. Abbie co-hosts Francophile, CFMU’s French-language radio show.
